customManagers.description: Update Makefile tool versions via inline renovate comments. The currentValue capture matches semver-shaped strings (optional v-prefix + digit + word/dot/plus/hyphen chars) so an image@sha256:... ref would not silently match.

Track AndriyKalashnykov/catalyst (the canonical catalyst repo) by release TAG. CATALYST_REF holds a v-prefixed semver tag (e.g. v1.3.0), so this uses the github-tags datasource and captures the tag as currentValue. catalyst tags releases but does not cut formal GitHub Releases, so github-tags (not github-releases) is the correct datasource. The CATALYST_REF packageRule below carves out automerge:false because catalyst bumps are API-affecting.

packageRules.description: Wait 3 days before automerging major updates

Disable the one-time `pin` update type globally. Caret ranges in package.json (vitest, @vitest/coverage-v8) and floating Dockerfile tags (node:24-alpine) are intentional — normal patch/minor/digest updates already keep them current, and pinning to exact would freeze them. `pinDigest` stays on so GitHub Actions remain SHA-pinned via `helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests`. Complements the Makefile-tools `pinDigests: false` rule below (the rules are orthogonal: this one targets the `pin` update type for ranges; that one targets `pinDigests` for docker refs).

Keep Makefile docker tool pins tag-only — `config:best-practices` transitively enables `docker:pinDigests` which would otherwise rewrite the Makefile constants to `tag@sha256:...` form, breaking the customManager regex (which expects a semver-shaped currentValue). Pinning by tag is acceptable here because each constant is also consumed via `docker pull`/`docker run` at build/lint time, which always resolves the latest digest for the tag.

The `# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.25@sha256:...` frontend directive is a deliberately-floating major tag (1.25 receives ongoing patch releases). Keep it digest-refreshed but never let docker:pinDigests open a separate pin PR against the floating tag.
Group GitHub Actions into one PR
Group aquasecurity ecosystem (Trivy action + CLI tool pin)
Catalyst pin — open PR but never automerge (breaking-change risk: catalyst bumps are API-affecting).
